 TOI Entertainment Desk / etimes.in / Oct 25, 2026, 14:03 IST Save Comments Share Aa + Text Size Small
 Medium
 Large
 Print ' Ramayana ', one of 2026’s most awaited films, is inching closer to release. Nitesh Tiwari’s mythological drama stars Ranbir Kapoor , Yash and Sai Pallavi , and sets out to revisit an epic battle fought for love, dharma and dignity. To build excitement, the makers have unveiled 'Mangal Rang', a new song featuring Ranbir and Sai Pallavi as Rama and Sita. Shreya Ghoshal and Arijit Singh lend their voices to the track, which has lyrics by Kumar Vishwas. A R Rahman and Hans Zimmer have composed the film’s music. ‘Mangal Rang’ gets warm response online
 'Mangal Rang' was released on Sunday, October 25, and social media was quick to respond. Several viewers appreciated the romantic number for its visuals, while many dubbed it the 'Brahmastra' of 'Ramayana'. Arijit and Shreya’s vocals drew praise too, as did the sweet chemistry between Ranbir and Pallavi. Watch Top Viral Moments From Ramayana Trailer Launch At Bharat Mandapam In New Delhi Netizens on Ranbir Kapoor and Sai Pallavi’s chemistry in ‘Mangal Rang’
 One X user wrote, “Ranbir Kapoor’s emotion meter should be taught in acting schools. I have never seen him overdo or underdo any emotion. Everything he does feels like exactly the right amount. That’s why it never feels like he is acting. It feels like he is actually living the moment.” Another commented, “It looks really Cute. How they are showing the Slow and Sweet Bonding of Prabhu Ram and Sita Mata in their Vanvaas.. The Eye Contact and Subtle Emotions looks really really Cute.” A third user posted, “The song, lyrics, and music—and these two are looking so, so good!” Praising the track, another said, “Mangal Rang from Ramayana is so melodious and the visuals are so grand and beautiful. Also that smile of Sai Pallavi as Sita ji was so heartwarming.” One tweet read, “Mangal Rang sunke lagta hai jaise Ram Yug wapas aa gaya ho. Itna pure, itna pavitra, itna apna… bas yahi feel.” Another fan wrote, “Absolutely LOVING the vibe of #MangalRang. The vibrant visuals, the divine colours, the majestic aura, and that ethereal atmosphere are EVERYTHING. It feels so rich, soulful and magical.” ‘Ramayana’ release date and cast
 'Ramayana' is backed by Namit Malhotra’s Prime Focus Studios and Yash’s Monster Mind Creations. It will arrive in theatres, including in 3D and IMAX 3D, on November 5. The ensemble cast also features Sunny Deol, Yash, Ravi Dubey, Rakul Preet Singh, Arun Govil and Lara Dutta, among others.
